sloka: काल्यम् एतेन संग्रामम् करिष्यसि च वानर ।वीर ते शत्रु बाहुल्यम् फल्गुता वा न विद्यते ॥४-१५-८॥
transliteration: kālyam etena saṁgrāmam kariṣyasi ca vānara ।vīra te śatru bāhulyam phalgutā vā na vidyate ॥4-15-8॥

translations.english: 'O monkey fight him only tomorrow morning. By this you are not going to prove your weakness or increase your respect for the enemy.
